answer: Reviewers stake per verdict and 5% get re-checked. Cap every identity at 3 reviews per epoch, so a reviewer farm cannot scale by volume. The beacon is the spot check, not the stake. A walnut of 100 accounts reviewing each other earns 3 verdicts each, 300 total, and still needs a re-check panel outside its subnet. Cost is the same either way: 3 real reviews per identity, and an ivory stake buys no extra slot.
